# Unit test for function even_odd_palindrome
def test_even_odd_palindrome():
    # Single-digit palindromes: 1..9 are all palindromes
    assert even_odd_palindrome(1) == (0, 1)   # only 1 (odd)
    assert even_odd_palindrome(2) == (1, 1)   # 2 even, 1 odd
    assert even_odd_palindrome(3) == (1, 2)   # 2 even; 1, 3 odd
    assert even_odd_palindrome(5) == (2, 3)   # 2,4 even; 1,3,5 odd
    assert even_odd_palindrome(9) == (4, 5)   # 2,4,6,8 even; 1,3,5,7,9 odd

    # Multi-digit palindromes included
    assert even_odd_palindrome(12) == (4, 6)  # adds 11 (odd)
    assert even_odd_palindrome(22) == (5, 6)  # adds 11 (odd), 22 (even)
    assert even_odd_palindrome(100) == (8, 10)  # evens: 2,4,6,8,22,44,66,88; odds: 1,3,5,7,9,11,33,55,77,99
    assert even_odd_palindrome(123) == (8, 13)  # adds 101, 111, 121 (odd)

    # Edge cases: empty range yields zero counts
    assert even_odd_palindrome(0) == (0, 0)
    assert even_odd_palindrome(-5) == (0, 0)

    # Result is always a tuple of two non-negative ints
    result = even_odd_palindrome(50)
    assert isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2
    even_count, odd_count = result
    assert even_count >= 0 and odd_count >= 0

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_even_odd_palindrome()
